resolutionRules: Read the current registry linked from the private student directory; count and scope are dynamic.
Prefer opaque studentId. A display name may yield multiple candidates; never merge duplicate names.
Intersect dated work with confirmed enrollment intervals; unknown boundaries remain uncertain and simultaneous courses remain distinct.
Resolve Assignment requirements through referenced evidence and the homework module. PreviewVideoRequirement and ProblemSectionRequirement use separate routes.
Read current student view for practical summary and canonical module snapshots for provenance. Return limited coverage with every answer.
Find site actions in canonical Cartography using intent; teacher practice does not grant execution authority.
교재별 흐름은 학생 디렉터리의 현재 academy-student-book-flows 모듈을 읽고 StudentID·BookEditionID·AssignmentID로 결합한다. 빈 과제 링크를 미배정으로 추정하지 않는다.
교재 이름은 학년-학기-권 표시와 학교급·판본 배지를 분리한다. 실제 위계가 미확인인 단계와 단원별 섹션 존재를 임의로 채우지 않는다.
미수행 누락은 정확한 범위의 명시적 판단으로만 표시하며 미조회·매핑 불명·기한 경과 미확인과 구분한다.
outputs: canonical IDs and minimal relevant fields
next allowed step or focused question

preconditions: User explicitly confirms the student is within managed scope.
Resolve possible duplicate names without harvesting other students.
localActions: Allocate a new opaque stable StudentID; external IDs remain null until observed and needed.
Append minimal enrollment evidence with validity interval; unknown boundaries remain null.
Create one private child Page and one derived view record; add allowlist entry and regenerate counts.
historyPreservation: Do not repurpose another student's ID or records.

preconditions: User or permitted source confirms the relevant course/schedule transition and effective date; uncertainties remain explicit.
localActions: Append a new Enrollment record and link it to the existing StudentID.
Record an end boundary only when supported; retain source-specific interval confidence.
Route assignments by date and version; preserve simultaneous-course enrollment when observed.
historyPreservation: Do not rewrite past assignments or collapse versions with equal titles.
Retain previous enrollment, source observations and teacher overrides.

preconditions: User confirms management ends and the effective date.
localActions: Mark local management state ended and remove from active refresh selection.
Keep its private historical Page and registry links available.
historyPreservation: No destructive deletion; enrollment and work history remain linked.
Management end does not imply website unenrollment or revoked account.

compatibilityRules: Keep stable student and entity IDs across revisions.
Old published files remain immutable history; update only explicit current-head links.
Version schema changes and record migration provenance; do not force unknown values into completion.
Preserve original Workspace catalog and academy r1-r4 snapshots.
requiredRegressionTests: inclusive date intersection and unknown interval handling
recent snapshot cannot claim full-history completion
preview video cannot become a problem section

refreshContract.registryDiscovery: Read the current canonical registry and publication receipt linked from this directory. Resolve file references using this same original directory Page. Never use an archived revision as the current head.

environment.offlinePolicy: If Gang-a PC is offline or the existing task is busy, skip or wait without starting an overlapping browser. Preserve prior records and report the source-specific blocker.
environment.loginPolicy: Use the authorized existing Gang-a PC session only. Do not create a cloud login, install dependencies, store credentials or bypass blocked access.

scope.studentSelection: Only active, user-confirmed managed students in the current private registry. Resolve ambiguous names with stable internal ID plus confirmed enrollment; stop rather than choose another person.

readPlan.action: Read the directory, canonical registry and target Pages; recheck owner-only permissions and current managed-block hashes.
readPlan.scope: Registry allowlist only; no fixed student count.
validation: Owner-only access and complete inherited-access observation required before personal-data write.
Resolve stable student ID. Names and row indices are not identifiers.
Retain all user-added or modified blocks and teacher assertions.

readPlan.action: Read DaysMain retrospective non-input table; capture latest dated lesson and assigned requirements separately.
readPlan.scope: Current month; previous month only if needed to locate the current assignment.
validation: Verify result-row student and actual date after waiting for async search.
Discard stale or empty tables until filter application and target rows are established.
Exclude sensitive memo column; distinguish scheduled future assignment from completed class.
Do not edit autosave DayRecord fields.

readPlan.action: Check a course/version change when relevant; retain historical interval and as-of metadata.
readPlan.scope: Managed student's enrolled courses only; previously read evidence remains older unless actually re-read.
validation: Same title may have multiple simultaneous courses or versions.
Do not infer enrollment start/end from missing records or an expired period label.
Unknown interval stays null; do not treat as a verified all-time enrollment.

readPlan.action: Use TeacherPrestudySummary and pending/completed preview views for the required subsection.
readPlan.scope: Rolling seven days, extended only when the current assignment requires older evidence.
validation: Video is an independent requirement, never a problem-book section.
Reapply student filter after tab changes.
Video OK, AI report or stars do not establish teacher inspection completion.
Site event timezone stays unknown until verified.

readPlan.action: Read TestPageList graded records and compare assignment date, book version, section and range.
readPlan.scope: Recent three weeks and exact student's courses; extend to one month only when assignment matching requires it.
validation: Input name alone is insufficient; the returned row must match the managed student.
Old original grades cannot complete a new correction or clinic task.
Catalog paper codes are not native attempt IDs. Record unknown joins explicitly.
Partial section matches do not cover all assigned pages; header/page/question mapping may remain ambiguous.
Paper-only assignment exception removes home app/grade requirement but leaves paper and in-class review unchecked.

readPlan.action: Record requested and observed windows, pagination, source exhaustion and per-requirement status.
readPlan.scope: Recent incremental refresh; full-history baseline remains separately versioned.
validation: Not checked, queried-but-not-observed, partial, ambiguous, exception and teacher-confirmed are distinct.
Catalog denominator is not assigned-required denominator.
Do not infer overall historical progress or absence from a recent window.
Attendance/makeup remain not checked unless explicitly read within the allowed task.

writePlan: Build a minimal typed revision that references stable student, enrollment, assignment and evidence IDs. Do not duplicate canonical records into each Page file.
Check current private access immediately before publishing personal data.
Upsert only managed block IDs whose current hashes equal lastPublishedHash. On mismatch, preserve the teacher edit and report conflict.
Preserve teacher notes, assertions, historical enrollment and prior source timestamps. New observations append provenance; they do not silently overwrite conflicting facts.
Upload the new immutable registry revision to this directory, validate schema and cross-references, read back bytes and hash, then advance its current-head link.
Read every changed student Page back; record source-specific read/write outcomes in a new receipt.
Set lastSuccessfulScheduledRefreshAt only after the scheduled run's private writes and readbacks actually succeed. Initial publication is not a scheduled run.
새 관찰을 해당 학생·교재·과제 범위에 연결한 뒤 교재 흐름 모듈을 재투영한다. 과거 관찰의 asOf를 새 관찰처럼 올리지 않는다.
교재 흐름 블록도 현재 StudentView.managedBlocks의 lastPublishedHash와 비교한다. 사용자 수정과 protectedManualBlockIds는 보존한다.
섹션 vocabulary를 모든 단원 인스턴스나 필수 배정으로 확장하지 않는다. 알 수 없는 위계·권·판본은 미확인으로 유지한다.
failurePolicy: Offline, stale table, filter failure, unknown identity, privacy uncertainty, canceled or denied transfer: stop the dependent module and keep prior data intact.
Never retry uncertain PDF generation, printing, grading or other effects as part of this read-only refresh.
A partial source refresh does not make other modules fresh. Failed modules retain their old as-of and receive failure metadata.
When authorized source data cannot be transferred, do not bridge through files or another worker.
successDefinition: All written data belong to the current allowlist and owner-only destination.
Every updated module has its own observed window, scope and provenance.
Schema, no-orphan references and guarded Page writes pass; readback confirms the published version.
Report partial success honestly; configured automation and an initial publication do not prove unattended operation.
